statement.en: The GitHub topic is synchronized daily. Automatic inclusion requires a pinned public commit, a root package manifest with dsh.bundle.patch, a safe root-relative patch path, committed runtime output, and source documentation. This is not a security audit or official endorsement.
statement.zh: GitHub Topic 每日同步。自动收录要求固定公开 commit、根 package.json 声明 dsh.bundle.patch、补丁路径安全且相对仓库根目录、运行产物已提交并具有源码文档。这不等于安全审计或官方背书。

description.en: A cat runs across the bottom of the DeepSeek Harness web UI with a synthesized meow every time a conversation turn ends.
